commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java code with project conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
The coding-standard update uses literal command offsets and a switch
layout that differs from the project convention.

Extract the command offsets into private constants and align switch
labels with the project convention. Preserve all existing behavior and
output.

the convention used by this project.

Record the project-specific switch layout while retaining all other
SE-EDU requirements.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Todo, Deadline, and Event task types
Replace command magic values with constants

commitResults.messageBody:
Luke.main currently handles input control, command dispatch, task
creation, and completion updates in one long method. This obscures the
top-level interaction flow and duplicates related command details.

Extract focused helpers so main reads at one level of abstraction.
Centralize task addition and task-number parsing to keep related state
updates together while preserving existing behavior and output.

Move command-word and task-number parsing out of Luke so that Parser owns command syntax interpretation. This keeps Luke focused on application flow, removes duplicated parsing responsibilities, and preserves existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle unrecognized commands without adding tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Remove the misleading behavior that stored unrecognized commands as generic tasks. Unknown commands now produce a user-facing message through Ui while leaving the task list unchanged.

Add a project-specific fail-fast UI regression testing skill and Level-4 test plan covering Todo, Deadline, Event, listing, marking, and unmarking. Update agent instructions so the UI test plan is reviewed and the test-ui skill is invoked after production code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve Java documentation and coding standards
commitResults.messageBody: Expand the project Java coding-standard guidance using the SE-EDU basic and intermediate conventions while preserving the CS2113 switch indentation convention. Add missing class and public-method Javadocs to the current task and UI classes. The changes preserve application behavior, DocLint reports no errors, and all 6 UI regression tests pass.
